Mixed reactions to Jerry Jones amid Cowboys struggles

Coverage presents conflicting views on Jerry Jones. One headline frames his comments as a 'swipe' at the owner amidst team struggles, while another quotes him as 'disappointed' and eager to improve the roster before the trade deadline. These opposing angles create a mixed tone regarding his current standing and attitude.
